answer_1.quote: Question Generation (QG) aims to generate questions from a given answer and a grounding paragraph.

answer_2.quote: Following , we adopt several metrics to evaluate diversity and consistency: 1) Top-1 BLEU measures BLEU of the best generated output; 2) Oracle BLEU reflects the overall consistency by comparing the best hypothesis among top-N outputs with the target question. 3) Pairwise BLEU (or Self BLEU) measures the diversity by averaging sentence-level metrics of pairs within top N. ... Note that all the mentioned BLEU indicate BLEU-4.

answer_4.quote: each sample has been checked by three annotators.
answer_4.guideline: evaluate the consistency and diversity: consistency measures the proportion of generated questions being answerable without hallucinations; diversity counts the number of distinct questions among the consistent ones
